description: This file defines the Toleration struct and associated methods for matching tolerations and tolerating taints in Kubernetes, including logic for comparison operators and numeric value parsing.

classes.name: Toleration
classes.description: Struct representing a toleration in Kubernetes, used to tolerate taints on nodes.

methods.name: MatchToleration
methods.description: Checks if the current toleration matches another toleration based on key, effect, operator, and value.

methods.name: ToleratesTaint
methods.description: Determines if the toleration tolerates a given taint, considering effect, key, operator, and value, including numeric comparisons.
